arabic text: KARBALA YEH BATA MERA BHAIYYA KAHA HAI GAYA
english translation text: 'O KARBALA, TELL ME, WHERE HAS MY BROTHER GONE'

arabic text: KARBALA YEH BATA MERA BHAIYYA KAHA HAI GAYA\nZULJANA AAGAYA ROKE ZAINAB NE THA YUN KAHA
english translation text: 'O KARBALA, TELL ME, WHERE HAS MY BROTHER GONE'\nZAINAB SAID CRYING WHEN ZULJANA RETURNED

arabic text: BIBI ZAINAB NE ABBAS KO KIYA MAQTAL MEIN JAAKE GILA\nTUM BHI DARYA PE JAA SOGAYE AB MERA KOWN HAI AASRA,\n AA BHI JAA GHAZIYAAN DUKHI ZAINAB KA PARDA BANA
english translation text: BIBI ZAINAB SAID TO ABBAS ON THE BATTEFIELD,\nYOU HAVE ALSO GONE TO SLEEP BY THE RIVER, NOW WHO WILL GIVE ME HOPE,\nO’ GHAZI, COME AND SAVE ZAINAB'S VEIL

arabic text: CHADAARE CHIN GAYI AAL KI ZAHRA SAANI KO QAID KIYA\nABIDE NATAWAAN KE GALE TAUQ ZAALIM NE PEHNA DIYA,\nBE PALA UNTH THAY AUR KUMBA MUHAMMAD KA THA
english translation text: THE VEILS OF THE FAMILY HAVE BEEN SNATCHED AWAY, ZAHRA'S DAUGHTER HAS BEEN MADE CAPTIVE,\nCOME AND SEE THE SHACKLES AROUND SAJJAD'S NECK THAT THE CRUEL MEN HAVE PUT,\nNOW IT JUST THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD(S) AND SADDLE-LESS CAMELS.

arabic text: JAB THA KUFA KE BAZAAR MEI KAFILA QAIDION KA GAYA\nKUFIYON NE SITAM YE KIYA PATHARO KANI BARSA DIYA,BAALON KO KOHL KAR LIYA ZAINAB NE PARDA BANA
english translation text: WHEN THE CARAVAN OF CAPTIVES PASSED THROUGH THE BAZAAR OF KUFA, THE KUFANS COMMITTED\nATROCITIES BY THROWING STONES, ZAINAB DIDN’T EVEN HAVE HER VEIL TO PROTECT HERSELF

arabic text: CHADAREN CHIN GAYI AAL KI, ZAHRA SAANI KO QAIDI KIYA\nAABIDE NAATAWAAN KE GALE, TAWK ZAALIM NE PEHNA DIYA\nBE PULLAAN, OONTH THE, AUR KUMBA MUHAMMAD KA THA
english translation text: THE CHADAR OF AHLUL IS TAKEN, THE DAUGHTER OF ZAHRA IS\nMADE A PRISONER THERE ARE CHAINS ON THE NECK OF ZAINUL ABIDEEN.\nTHE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD HAD NO SHADE RIDING ON THE CAMELS

arabic text: JAB THE KUFA KE BAZAAR MEIN, KAFELA KAIDIYON KA GAYA\nKUFIYON NE SITAM YE KIYA, PATHARON KA NI BARSA DIYA\nBAALON KO, KHOL KAR, KIYA ZAINAB NE PARDA BANA
english translation text: IN THE BAZAAR, THE PEOPLE OF\nKUFA RAINED STONES ON THE PRISONERS\nZAINAB COVERED HER FACE WITH HER HAIR
